description: Explicit per-repository publication policy. prBase names the branch a product-opened pull request must target when it is not the remote's default branch. A repository absent here uses origin/HEAD; a prBase that does not exist on origin refuses publication rather than guessing.

FreshStartFamily.reason: .github/workflows/enforce-staging-flow.yml and enforce-release-flow.yml: feature branches target staging; only staging may target main.
